# Lambda Capital

Lambda Capital provides growth capital to profitable, bootstrapped vertical software companies, so founders can fund their next hires, contracts or products without raising venture capital.

Public site copy describes growth capital only. Lambda Capital does not buy, acquire, own, or operate portfolio companies, and does not offer exit, succession, selling, or a permanent home.
